# Derick Mokua - Backend Developer & Cybersecurity Engineer

> Portfolio, technical specifications, and engineering services of Derick Mokua, Nairobi-based Backend Developer and Cybersecurity Engineer specializing in high-throughput distributed systems, AI integration safety, and zero-trust perimeters.

## Overview
Derick Mokua designs and builds resilient, fault-tolerant backend infrastructures, real-time data pipelines, and secure AI-enabled applications. With deep expertise across Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Rust, and Linux systems engineering, he bridges the gap between scalable server design and defensive security.

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Backend Architecture**: High-performance REST/GraphQL/WebSocket APIs, microservices decomposition, database indexing, caching strategies, and concurrency controls.
- **AI Safety & Integration**: RAG pipeline engineering, deterministic safeguard proxies, frontier model orchestration, and prompt security evaluation.
- **Defensive Security & Infrastructure**: Zero-trust architecture, automated vulnerability scanning, least-privilege access enforcement, and hardened cloud deployments (AWS, Docker, Linux).

## Featured Projects & Systems
- **KukuConnect**: Agricultural platform delivering real-time diagnostics, USSD/WhatsApp integrations, and farm management telemetry across unreliable networks.
- **KukuConnect FMS**: Offline-first farm management system featuring conflict-free synchronization, edge caching, and automated hatch rate monitoring.
- **Saibae**: Deterministic AI safety proxy intercepting and sanitizing untrusted inputs with sub-second policy validation.
- **WhatsLove**: High-concurrency WebSocket messaging assistant optimized for low latency and distributed user sessions.
- **Online Poll System**: Cryptographically audited voting architecture ensuring verifiable integrity and real-time ballot tallying.

## Publications & Research

- *Defensive Security: Building Resilient Systems in an Ever-Evolving Threat Landscape*
- *Ethical Hacking 101: Understanding the Rules of Engagement and Data Protection*
